pages.text: INFLUENCER AGREEMENT. Creator agrees to deliver one (1) Reel. Payment terms: NET 30. Term: 30 days from publication. Creator grants Brand a 12-month, non-exclusive license to use the content for organic social only. Exclusivity: 14 days post-publish, fitness category only. Brand approval required, with up to 2 rounds of revisions within 5 business days each.

Disclosure: Creator shall include #ad in the post per FTC Endorsement Guides. Termination: either party may terminate with 7 days written notice and a 14-day cure period. Kill fee: 50% of the deal value if Brand cancels within 7 days of shoot date.
